title: 第8章 贫穷是剑峰的命
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“行吧，行吧，我都听师父的。”

    怕真的把师父气出好歹，林不语连连应道。

    等人心情平复了，两人这才齐齐望向微生璃月和濮阳明珠。

    他们记得，今天好像是宗门招生的日子，没猜错的话，这两人可能就是他们的师妹了。

    “好了，现在给你们介绍一下，这两位是为师今年新收的弟子，这位是濮阳明珠，你们的四师妹，这位是微生璃月，你们的五师妹。”

    说着，李归鸿还悄悄给两人传音：“切记，千万、千万、千万不要惹到你们五师妹，不然到时候出了事，师父可保不住你们。”

    “明珠还有璃月，这两位分别是你们二师姐陆明薇和三师兄林不语，一个喜欢炼丹，一个喜欢修炼。”

    “不过你们平时没事少往他们那里跑，容易被误伤。”李归鸿仔细叮嘱道。

    趁这两个弟子刚入门，还没惹上她们几个师兄师姐的坏毛病，说不定这次自己可以改变剑峰专出魔丸的传统。

    “知道了，师父。”两人异口同声回答。

    从刚刚发生的事可以看出，这几个师兄师姐都不是好惹的主。

    短短一刻钟，两座房子相继倒塌，怪不得这个便宜师父这么抠门，微生璃月现在都开始有些理解他了。

    “你们好啊，四师妹，五师妹，我是你们二师姐陆明薇，第一次见面，没准备什么礼物，这是我自己练的补气丹，送给你们。咳咳……”说着，陆明薇又开始咳，看起来身体不太好。

    “你们要是修炼上有什么问题，也可以来找我指点。”

    虽然不知道师父为什么说不要惹到小师妹，但她看人家还挺好相处的。

    “嗯，谢谢二师姐。”

    两人接过玉瓶，礼貌道谢。

    李归鸿站在一旁看着，他还以为像璃月这样从小天材地宝养大的大小姐，会看不上明薇这点丹药，没想到她竟然收下了。

    看来她也不全是嚣张骄纵，只要不惹到人家，她还是挺好相处的。

    林不语见二师姐给两位师妹送见面礼，想掏一下储物袋看看有没有合适的礼物送给她们。
content_en:
"Okay, okay, I will listen to Master."

Afraid of really making Master angry, Lin Buyu responded repeatedly.

After everyone calmed down, they both looked at Weisheng Liyue and Puyang Mingzhu.

They remembered that today seemed to be the sect's recruitment day. If they guessed correctly, these two people might be their junior sisters.

"Okay, now let me introduce you to these two new disciples that I have accepted this year. This is Puyang Mingzhu, your fourth junior sister, and this is Weisheng Liyue, your fifth junior sister."

After saying that, Li Guihong also quietly sent a message to the two of them: "Remember, never, never, never offend you Fifth Junior Sister, otherwise if something happens, Master will not be able to protect you."

"Mingzhu and Liyue, these two are your second senior sister Lu Mingwei and third senior brother Lin Buyu. One likes to make alchemy and the other likes to practice."

"But if you have nothing to do, don't run to them. You may be accidentally injured." Li Guihong warned carefully.

While these two disciples are just getting started and haven't gotten into the bad habits of their senior brothers and sisters, maybe this time I can change Jianfeng's tradition of specializing in magic pills.

"I understand, Master." They both replied in unison.

It can be seen from what just happened that these senior brothers and sisters are not easy to mess with.

In just a quarter of an hour, the two houses collapsed one after another. No wonder this cheap master was so stingy. Weisheng Liyue now began to understand him somewhat.

"Hello, Fourth Junior Sister, Fifth Junior Sister, I am your Second Senior Sister, Lu Mingwei. It's our first time meeting you. I didn't prepare any gifts. This is the Qi Replenishing Pill I practiced for you. Ahem..." As she said that, Lu Mingwei started coughing again, and she seemed to be in poor health.

"If you have any questions about your cultivation, you can come to me for advice."

Although she didn't know why the master said not to mess with the junior sister, she thought she was quite easy to get along with.

"Well, thank you, Second Senior Sister."

The two took the jade bottle and politely thanked them.

Li Guihong stood aside and watched. He thought that a young lady like Liyue, who had been raised with natural resources, would look down on Mingwei's elixir, but he didn't expect that she would accept it.

It seems that she is not all arrogant and arrogant. As long as she doesn't offend others, she is quite easy to get along with.

Lin Buyu saw the second senior sister giving gifts to the two junior sisters, and wanted to take out the storage bag to see if there were any suitable gifts for them.
